reconciliation.method: Nine live checks (R1-R9) were executed this pass against the running cluster. Keys directly re-confirmed live NOW: audit_enabled, failed_login, authenticated, ssl_exception, rbac_change_events, retention_180d, access_restricted, monitor_alert, and category-enablement for missing_privileges. Keys reconciled to already-verified persisted evidence rather than re-executed: security_index_denial, old_credential_events, authorization_headers_absent, cookies_absent, credentials_absent, secret_derived_absent, sensitive_bodies_absent, capacity_guard.
reconciliation.why_reconciled_not_reexecuted: Those eight were each independently verified LIVE earlier in Phase 85 (negative tests N1-N14, the exhaustive 140,642-document sensitive-field scroll scan, the old-credential FAILED_LOGIN attribution, and the disk-watermark/forecast capture - all recorded verbatim in phase85-audit-snapshot.json) and independently again in Phase 84. Re-running the exhaustive scan would add load without adding truth, and minting fresh denial events would cross a security/credential mutation gate this read-only pass did not cross. Their supporting configuration invariants WERE re-confirmed live this pass: exclude_sensitive_headers=true and log_request_body=false (R2) are the mechanisms that make the five sensitive-field keys true.
reconciliation.drift_detected: none. Every value re-checked this pass matches the corresponding value in phase85-evidence-audit.json / phase85-audit-snapshot.json, except monotonic document-count and timestamp growth, which is the expected signature of a healthy, still-capturing audit pipeline.

read_only_attestation: Every request issued by this recheck was an HTTP GET, or a POST to a query-only endpoint (_search). Zero PUT, PATCH or DELETE was issued to any endpoint, index, template, ISM policy, alerting monitor, role, role mapping, internal user, or cluster setting. No user or role was created or removed. No container was started, stopped, restarted or reconfigured. No live configuration file was modified. No pre-existing evidence artifact was rewritten. The only files created are additive, reversible artifacts under ops/reports/evidence/phase85/ and ops/reports/generated/phase85/.
secret_handling_attestation: No secret value, no secret-derived fingerprint and no password hash appears in this file, in phase85-evidence-audit.json, or in any of the 90 Phase 85 audit reports. Authentication used the admin TLS client certificate referenced by file path only; the private key was never opened or read. No credential was placed in argv, in an environment dump, or in any log. Only the NAMES of the variables in /opt/wazuh-docker/multi-node/ops/creds.env were ever listed, never a value. The audit index was never queried FOR a secret value, which would itself have written that value into a query string and into the audit log; sensitive-field verification is by field name and pattern class only. The single audit.ignore_users entry is withheld because that account name is byte-identical to its own credential.
